title: Legacy Custom E-Commerce Platform Overhaul
description: Evaluating whether to pay a local digital marketing agency a final milestone fee to patch a buggy, custom-built web application, or scrap it for a turnkey system.
assumptions: The additional $6,500 milestone payment actually fixes the checkout basket drop-off errors.
The agency delivers the update within the agreed 45-day window without scoping additional fees.
Local search engine baseline visibility remains stable despite ongoing platform core changes.
